name: Aztecan
source: https://aztecan.net/ (styles.bundle.css: shared/design.css and styles.css; shared/particles.js), read 2026-11-25
summary: Near-black with a white halo, glass panels behind hairlines, a cyan signal with mint and violet beside it; Inter; 8px panels, pill-shaped controls; a fine 80px grid that fades at the edges.
_modes: The site is dark only. Its design system names a white sister site (the team portal) that shares type and shape but not colour; that portal is not public. The light values below are derived, and every derived value says so in its role.

color._note: Hex sRGB. A fill tone is for areas, strokes and marks; a text tone is the same hue at >= 4.5:1 on surface.base and surface.raised. Translucent site values are also given flattened over surface.base.

base.role: page. Dark: --bg. Light (derived): the site's --text, so the light base is the dark ink

sunken.role: inputs, secondary areas. Dark: white 4.5% on base (.secondary-action rgba(255,255,255,.045))

raised.role: panels, cards. Dark: --panel rgba(18,18,22,.72) flattened on base

overlay.role: menus, popovers. Dark: the mobile menu rgba(13,14,19,.97)

hover.role: hover fill. Dark: .nav a:hover, white 8% on base. Light (derived): the site's --accent silver

muted.role: secondary text, lead paragraphs. Dark: --muted (8:1). Light (derived): zinc pulled to 5.3:1 on sunken

soft.role: dates, small upper-case labels. Dark: --soft, 4.3:1 on base: labels only

softText.role: soft ink that must reach 4.5:1 on raised surfaces (4.8:1)

bright.role: hovered edges, input edges, icon rings. Dark: --line-bright

fill.role: the primary action. Dark: .primary-action, a white pill (linear-gradient #ffffff to #c9cbd1) with a white glow; flattened to --accent #e8edf7. Light (derived): inverted to near-black

onFill.role: label on the primary fill. Dark: .primary-action color

signal._note: Cyan is the one colour that means 'look here': focus outlines, links, meta labels, range accents. Mint and violet are secondary accents used sparingly (status, a third series).

cyan.role: accent fill and strokes. --cyan. In light mode only for marks and strokes, never under or as text

cyanText.role: cyan carrying text, or under white text. Light (derived): 5.6:1 on white, 5.1:1 on base

cyanBright.role: hover on a cyan fill; bright-blue ANSI slot

onCyan.role: text on a cyan fill: dark letters on the pale dark-mode cyan (12.6:1), as the site puts dark letters on its light pill

mint.role: ok, running, success. --green. Light (derived): 5.4:1 on white

violet.role: a third accent (background work). --violet. Light: no derived value yet; the host's own purple stays

halo.role: radial light at the top of the stage: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, halo, transparent 27rem). Light (derived): a cyan tint, because white on white does not show

ok.role: signal.mint; dots glow in dark: box-shadow 0 0 18px rgba(148,240,195,.55)

danger.role: error. Dark: between the site's error text #ffb4b4 and a red that still reads as a fill; dark letters on it (9:1)

grid.role: horizontal then vertical 1px lines (body::before), masked to fade: transparent, black 18%, black 68%, transparent. Light (derived): about double the alpha, because dark lines on white read weaker

particles.role: a drifting particle field on a canvas at 58% opacity (shared/particles.js). Animated; not applied to app targets

card.role: the glass card (.update-card): a lit top edge plus two drop shadows

type.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
type.webFonts: The site names Inter first but does not load it, so most visitors see their system UI font. Inter is OFL (Google Fonts); a target may load it to get the intended face.

eyebrow.role: section labels above headings; meta labels are 11.5px, cyan

shape._note: Containers are softly rounded (8px); controls are pills: buttons, the navigation track and its links, chips. Icons sit in 1px-ringed circles.

effects.hover: fill surface.hover and line.bright; cards lift 2px to 8px with a deeper shadow and a faint cyan glow (0 0 70px rgba(118,216,255,.12))
effects.glow: status dots and the primary pill glow in their own colour; the dark mode only

terminal._note: Only the base colours and the blue/green/magenta slots are the theme's; other ANSI colours stay as the host has them.
